items.title: Firms That Look Alike: Characteristic Graphs and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns
items.claim: In 2010–2024 U.S. stocks, graph neural networks on characteristic-based neighbours do not consistently beat a plain neural network using the same characteristics.

items.title: Opening the Black Box: Which News Explain LLM-Based Stock Ratings?
items.claim: In S&P 500 news summaries, topics explain LLM stock ratings beyond sentiment, lifting within-R² from 7.17% to 15.17%.
